query.text: 请帮我留意户外工作时的身体状态和环境，有不适或安全风险及时提醒我。
query.text_en: Please help me keep an eye on my physical condition and the environment during outdoor work, and alert me in time if there is any discomfort or safety risk.

annotation.text_zh: 天气炎热，请注意防暑，多喝水避免中暑。
annotation.text_en: It's really hot today, so stay cool and drink plenty of water to avoid heatstroke.
